value.rationale: Precisely quantifies how many experimentally relevant entanglement-generating ancilla contacts can accompany ideal battery charging at fixed bath noise. It establishes an exact thermal no-entanglement boundary and a sharp, unique singular optimal scaling, qualitatively different from the fixed-coupling logarithmic lifetime. The strict-positivity objective is explicitly separated from measurable magnitude and speed.
